ideas.idea: In a falling, agitated market, a one-day rise of up to about one usual swing that follows a steep fall over the previous four days is given back over the next day, only after the steepest four-day falls, and more the deeper that four-day fall against the coin's 30-day swing.
ideas.consequence: A trader would short a modest up day only when it interrupts a sharp several-day slide, for one day, sizing up with the slide's depth, and would leave alone the bounces after shallow slides.
ideas.name: bounce after steep slide fades

ideas.idea: In a falling, agitated market, a one-day rise of up to about one usual swing that follows a fall over the previous four days is given back over the next day, more the larger that day's rise against the coin's 30-day swing and the deeper the four-day fall before it.
ideas.consequence: A trader would short the larger of the modest up days inside a slide for one day, sizing with both the rise and the depth of the slide before it.
ideas.name: larger bounce in slide fades
